args.subject: Invoice Update & Late Fee Refund Confirmation
args.body:
Dear Fabrikam Billing Team,

We are writing to confirm the following updates for **Customer ID: C-7407 (Fabrikam Ltd)**:

1. **Billing Contact Update**: Your account has been updated to reflect the new billing contact email: **billing@fabrikam.co**.

2. **Late Fee Refund**: Your late fee refund of **$120** has been processed and should reflect in your account within **3-5 business days**. If you have not received the refund by then, please reply to this email or contact us.

Thank you for updating your contact details with us. Please reference **Ticket C-7407** for any follow-up inquiries.

Best regards,
Fabrikam Support Team
